decisions.reason: Existing technical validation work can proceed under the documented goals; the artifacts and scripts support checking but do not establish semantic correctness.
Technical lesson validation and revocation remain within the existing technical lifecycle; review evidence and scope before changing it.
Publishing private role memory outside its authorized scope changes permission and is not authorized by the existing technical work.

remaining: Run the documented role-memory tests and checker in the source repository, then inspect any failures and preserve their actual results.
Boundedly verify one authorized-scope memory save, retrieval, and revocation path against the role-memory contract; record inputs, outputs, and evidence without claiming causal benefit.
Do not publish private role memory beyond its authorized scope without a human permission decision.
General natural-language planning runtime and expert discovery/routing remain targets, not demonstrated deployed capabilities.
No evidence establishes memory adoption benefit, improved outcomes, or human time saved; proposal #23 remains under review.
